card.summary: The best model here for FURRY and PONY (My Little Pony) art -- a heavily re-trained SDXL with deep furry/anthro and pony concept coverage. NOT the pick for plain anime: for anime use Anima (highest quality) or AutismMix (faster). Requires the mandatory score-tag prompt system + CLIP skip 2; pick the source_ tag for the look you want.
card.pick_when: Best choice for FURRY/anthro or PONY (MLP) art (also general anime/cartoon and NSFW). Emit the score prefix + source_furry (furry/anthro) or source_pony (MLP) + clip_skip 2.

prompt.guidance: The required score-tag prefix is prepended automatically -- do NOT include it. Write the source_ tag for the look you want: source_furry for furry/anthro (add 'anthro' plus a species like 'wolf'/'fox'/'dragon', and tags like 'fur','tail'), source_pony for My Little Pony (add 'pony' or 'my little pony' plus character names like 'twilight sparkle'), or source_anime / source_cartoon. Then a rating_ tag (rating_safe/rating_questionable/rating_explicit) and booru comma tags and/or a description. CLIP skip 2 is required (applied for you).
prompt.required_prefix: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up
prompt.example: source_furry, rating_safe, anthro, male wolf, blue fur, green eyes, hoodie, city street at night, looking at viewer
prompt.overview: SDXL finetune: the required score-tag block is prepended automatically; write an optional source_ style tag and a rating_ tag, then danbooru tags / a short description.
prompt.instructions:
The full score block (the required_prefix: `score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up`) is prepended AUTOMATICALLY -- do NOT type it, and never use `score_9` alone.
Write, after that auto block: an optional source_ style tag, an optional rating_ tag, then your danbooru tags / description.
Rating tags control content: `rating_safe, rating_questionable, rating_explicit`.
Source/style tags select the art domain: `source_pony, source_furry, source_cartoon, source_anime`.
Template (what YOU write, after the auto score block): `<source_ tag>, <rating_ tag>, <describe what you want>, tag1, tag2`.
The special source_/rating_ tags keep their underscores (they are not danbooru tags). The model is designed to not need negatives in most cases, and does not need extra quality words like 'hd' or 'masterpiece'. Recommended: Euler a, 25 steps, 1024px.
do: Add a source_ tag (e.g. source_anime/source_furry) to pick the art style
Add a rating_ tag for content level
Let the app add the score block -- don't type it
dont: Type the score block yourself (it is auto-prepended)
examples: source_anime, rating_safe, 1girl, blue hair, looking at viewer, village background
source_pony, anthro pony, blue mane, smiling, sunny meadow
prompt.negative_guidance: Designed to not need negatives in most cases; no official negative string required.

negative.note: Usually NOT needed; keep minimal. Avoid heavy negative embeddings.

speed.measured_note: ~20s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 25 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Best for furry and My Little Pony art. Uses short comma tags -- add source_furry plus 'anthro' and a species (e.g. wolf, fox) for furry, or source_pony plus character names for MLP. Score/quality tags are added for you.
ui_help.good_for: furry, anthro & My Little Pony art (NOT plain anime — use Anima/AutismMix for that)
